simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַנְוָה (H6037) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַנְוָה (ʻanvâh) means mildness (royal); also (concretely) oppressed First listed occurrence: Ps 18 36.

definitions.full: H6037. anvah עֲנָוָה noun feminine humility: — Prov 15:33 3 t.; עַנְוָהֿ (contracted because of Maqqeph, see Br Mp ) Psa 45:5 ; עֶנְוָָֽתְךָ 18:36 (= עֲנֹתְךָ 2Sam 22:36 see I. ענה ; read עֶזְרָֽתְךְ Ol We); — 1 humility, meekness Psa 45:5 (dubious), Prov 15:33 ; 18:12 ; 22:4 ; Zeph 2:3 (probably gloss, see We Now). 2 condescension Psa 18:36 (dubious, see above).
